name: Stripe MCP
tagline: Read customer, payment, and subscription data from Stripe.
shortDescription: The official Stripe MCP server. List customers, retrieve charges, look up subscriptions, create payment links, issue refunds, and manage invoices. The canonical way to give an agent access to your payment data.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Stripe MCP server, maintained by Stripe. Exposes the most-used Stripe API endpoints as MCP tools: customers, charges, subscriptions, invoices, payment intents, refunds, and products. Read-only by default; write operations are opt-in.

## Why we recommend it

It's the only way to safely let an agent touch your Stripe data. The auth uses a restricted API key (you pick exactly which endpoints the agent can call), the read-only default prevents accidents, and the response shapes match Stripe's docs so debugging is easy. Without it, an agent that needs to look up a subscription or issue a refund would need a custom integration.

## When to use it

- Customer support agents that need to look up subscription state, refund a charge, or send an invoice
- Sales agents that pull MRR, churn, and plan distribution
- Internal tools that need to reconcile payments
- NOT for: agents that initiate new charges from chat (security risk)
installInstructions:
1. Get a restricted API key at https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys (recommend `rk_live_...` with read-only scope to start)
2. Set `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=rk_...`
3. `uv tool install stripe-mcp --with stripe`

**Production:** Use a restricted key. Never give the agent write access to charges or customers without a human-in-the-loop approval flow.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Stripe API access requires a Stripe account; API calls are billed per-request by Stripe.
